description: Structure-guided clustering of paired αβ T-cell receptor repertoires — groups TCRs by predicted CDR-loop geometry rather than sequence. Reproduce the paper's headline numbers in a few minutes with R alone: see README.md. Includes the Slurm pipeline, benchmarks against 9 sequence methods, and 137 tests.
